same_task_gate_leakage: Acceptance uses the same task that is reported (same-task leakage). This is NOT held-out val/test selection as in original SkillOpt / Lite.
note: Gate uses the same task (not held-out val). n=independent diagnosis samples; R=progressive repair rounds; L=merge/edit budget. Rejected proposals feed the next round. All prior failure trajectories (baseline + failed gates) are accumulated into later-round diagnosis/edit evidence.
